parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file passes. CatalogueService does the normal work of an application layer. It coordinates use cases (addProduct, listProducts) through an injected domain repository port, builds the domain entity Product, and converts entities into DTOs. Nothing in it handles persistence, HTTP or other transport, or framework concerns. The duplicate-id check in addProduct asks the repository whether the id exists and then throws a DomainError. Checking uniqueness across many items like this is commonly done when a use case is coordinated, and the entity's own rules stay inside the Product constructor. AddProductContextDto is a plain data-transfer interface with an optional requestId. It isn't used and it doesn't carry transport logic. Nothing here belongs to a different kind of layer.
